scope: One mathematical component audit of the frozen supplied proofs and exact controls; no manuscript/PDF assessment.
summary: The dimension minorization, continuous CP remainder, equal-reference trace/Umegaki upper factors, and sufficiently-large-output positive common-component envelope are valid under the stated hypotheses. Only minor endpoint notation and original-checker coverage wording need repair.

envelope.quantity: inf alpha_+(E o Psi) with square d-dimensional Psi, eta_tr(Psi)<=r, and admissible finite-dimensional EB E
envelope.r: 0<=r<=1 naturally; r>1 repeats the zero plateau
envelope.attainment: minimum attained by the classical exclusion-mixture family

claims.claim: Dual spectral-oscillation inequality with ordinary trace coefficient r
claims.reason: Extremal pure states, centered observable Holder inequality; no factor-two error. The duality itself is prior machinery.

claims.claim: b >= max(0,1-(d-1)r) for a square d-dimensional prefix
claims.reason: Integrate the minimum-eigenvalue/trace/oscillation bound; Psi* unital suffices, Psi need not be unital.

claims.claim: Measurability and finite-dimensional integrability
claims.reason: Minimum eigenvalues are continuous; positive matrix integrands have integrable trace. No measurable eigenvector selection is needed.

claims.claim: Actual preparation posterior law and minorization
claims.reason: Summing earlier records yields Tr(Psi*(F_a)rho); final posterior tau_a is independent of the input and earlier records.

claims.claim: Uniform block-length consequence under r <= q^(L-1)
claims.reason: Choose (d-1)q^(L-1)<1; retain environmental joint measurability, null-set, and indexing hypotheses.

claims.claim: Continuous Choi-integral CP remainder
claims.reason: Unnormalized input-first J has integrand (G_a-c_a I)^T tensor tau_a; positive and trace-integrable.

claims.claim: Trace normalization and substantive b=0/b=1 endpoint conclusions
claims.reason: Partial output trace equals (1-b)I; b=0 gives Omega=0, b=1 gives zero remainder.

claims.claim: Decomposition display labelled only when b>0
claims.reason: Minor presentation repair: use 0<b<1 with defined Q; give N=R_Omega separately at b=1, or explicitly choose arbitrary Q there.

claims.claim: Equal-reference complete trace-distance upper factor 1-b
claims.reason: Common replacer term cancels; Q tensor id is CPTP for every finite reference dimension.

claims.claim: Equal-reference complete Umegaki upper factor 1-b
claims.reason: Joint convexity and data processing; ratios require positive finite denominator; treat b=1 separately from 0 times infinity.

claims.claim: Planar continuum and rational four-point calibration
claims.reason: Circle second moments establish the continuum formula; finite exact checks reproduce b=1/2 with consistent density normalizations.

claims.claim: Positive CP common-component optimum 1/2 for the planar squared channel
claims.reason: Positive primal Omega and positive dual with Tr_input Z=I have equal objective 1/2; no SDP solver required.

claims.claim: Original EXACT1206 direct verification coverage
claims.reason: Original closure checks alone do not assert uniform invariant branch weights, and its iterate loop constructs closed forms. Supplement verifies weights and recursive channel application. The mathematical conclusions remain supported.

claims.claim: Classical exclusion-mixture family including its quantum ordinary trace coefficient
claims.reason: On trace-zero Hermitian inputs Psi_s=-s/(d-1) times dephasing; basis-state pairs attain the norm. alpha_+=1-s.

claims.claim: Exact positive common-component envelope under eta_tr(Psi)<=r
claims.reason: Minimum equals max(0,1-(d-1)r), attained using d classical outputs. The plateau uses <=r, not equality.

claims.claim: Pauli and deterministic-depolarizing adverse controls
claims.reason: They separate summed channels from recorded posterior kernels and trace/W1 convergence from posterior TV convergence.

claims.claim: Novelty or priority of the combined dimension/envelope result
claims.reason: Selected primary passages and bounded searches do not establish worldwide novelty; several building blocks are explicitly prior.

claims.claim: Sharp complete trace/Umegaki coefficients from the common-component envelope
claims.reason: No lower bound on these complete coefficients is supplied by tightness of alpha_+.

claims.claim: Sharpness with a fixed output dimension below d
claims.reason: The attaining classical construction uses d distinguishable outputs.

claims.claim: Capacity or full quenched limit-theorem consequences
claims.reason: Outside the supplied component and not proved by this audit.

claims.claim: Existing neighboring source direction flag as a paper-level refutation
claims.reason: Preserved as unresolved. The neighboring proof/PDF and the unspecified earlier diagnostic were not adjudicated.

scope_extension_falsifiers.extension: The same posterior minorization for arbitrary recorded unravelings
scope_extension_falsifiers.falsifier: d=2 four-Pauli recorded instrument: summed channel is replacement; delta_(I/2) and the uniform law on the two basis pure states are disjoint invariant laws.

scope_extension_falsifiers.extension: Remove equal reference marginals from complete trace/Umegaki contraction
scope_extension_falsifiers.falsifier: A replacer on A preserves all distance between product inputs differing only in a qubit R marginal.

scope_extension_falsifiers.extension: Representation mass b always equals the optimized channel or posterior common coefficient
scope_extension_falsifiers.falsifier: d=2, identity prefix, projective measurement, both labels prepare the same tau: b=0 but alpha_+=1 and posterior law delta_tau.

scope_extension_falsifiers.extension: Trace/W1 convergence implies posterior-law TV convergence
scope_extension_falsifiers.falsifier: The single-record depolarizing map yields distinct point masses at every finite L: TV=1 but trace/W1=2^(-L).

scope_extension_falsifiers.extension: The dimension CP component belongs to Psi without EB postprocessing
scope_extension_falsifiers.falsifier: d=2, Phi(X)=(Tr(X)I+X^T)/3: eta_tr=1/3 but alpha_+=0 from symmetric Choi support. Identity postprocessing is not EB.
